title: Open the global search palette with the keyboard shortcut (K / Cmd+K)
Open the global search palette by clicking the header search field
Close the palette with the Esc key
Toggle the palette closed by pressing the shortcut again (Cmd+K)
Close the palette by clicking the dimmed page behind it
Move through result rows with the Up and Down arrow keys, skipping group headers
Open the highlighted result in the same tab by pressing Enter
Open the highlighted result in a new browser tab with Cmd+Enter (Ctrl+Enter)
Move focus to the scope tab strip with Tab, then cycle tabs with Left and Right arrows
The keyboard shortcut legend stays visible in the footer at all times
The scope tab strip lists All plus the six entity tabs in the exact order
The 'All' tab shows results from every entity group together
The 'Work Orders' tab shows only Work Order results
The 'Customers' tab shows only Customer results
The 'Assets' tab shows only Asset (vehicle) results
The 'Parts' tab shows only Part (inventory) results
The 'Vendors' tab shows only Vendor results
The 'Part Sales' tab shows only Part Sales results
Each result group shows a heading with the total match count
A group shows up to five results (raised from three)
A 'Show all N' link appears when a group has more matches than are shown
Clicking 'Show all N' switches the palette into that entity's scope tab
Groups appear in the fixed order Work Orders, Customers, Assets, Parts, Vendors, Part Sales
The typed text is highlighted inside each matching result
A screen reader announces the results count when it changes
A Work Order result shows number, customer, status badge, assignee and date
A Customer result shows name, address and an open work-order count chip
An Asset result shows year/make/model and the owning customer
A Part result shows description, part number and a quantity chip colored by stock level
A Vendor result shows the vendor name and address
A Part Sale result shows the P-number, customer, status badge, total price and date
A customer or vendor matched on a phone or email shows 'Contact/info match'
Work Order status badges use the correct colors
A misspelled name still finds the record - 'Petersn' finds 'Peterson'
A misspelled name still finds the record - 'Abrige' finds 'Aabridge'
A transposed-letters query still finds the record - 'frieghtliner' finds 'Freightliner'
A phonetically-similar name still finds the record - 'Filbridge' finds 'Fibridge'
A Work Order number matches exactly with or without the dash or a space
A VIN / serial number requires an exact match after normalization
A telephone number matches on digits only, ignoring formatting
A part number requires an exact match after normalization
Typos in identifier fields do NOT return fuzzy matches
A soft (fuzzy) match is visually indicated
A Part Sale P-number requires an exact match (no fuzzy typo tolerance)
An exact identifier match is pinned as a single row at the very top
Within a group, more relevant results appear first
In-stock parts rank above out-of-stock parts (out-of-stock not hidden)
On a Customer page, that customer's assets and work orders are boosted
On a Work Order page, parts already on that work order are pushed down
First-time empty state shows the placeholder, helper text and three quick-create buttons
The quick-create buttons in the empty state start the matching create flow
Recent activity is grouped under Today, Yesterday, Past week and Past 30 days
Recent activity mixes different entity types using the same row template
Clicking a recent item opens that record
The typed query is retained in the header search field after the palette closes
Reopening the palette restores the last query, scope tab and result list
The persisted query can be cleared with the clear (x) button
No matches shows 'No results for <query>' plus the three quick-create buttons
A quick-create button in the no-results state starts the create flow
Hovering a Work Order result shows an 'Add new line' action
Hovering an Asset result shows 'New work order' plus history and checklist icons
Hovering a Customer result shows 'New work order' (and 'New contact')
Hovering a catalog part result shows 'Add part'
Hovering a Vendor result shows 'Add contact'
Hovering an inventory part while editing a work order shows 'Add to work order'
Hover quick-actions never trigger a destructive operation
Searching the in-page Work Orders list filters the list and shows a matching banner
'Clear search' restores the full in-page Work Orders list
A search failure shows the 'Search unavailable, retry' banner
A user WITH Parts access sees Parts results in the palette
A technician WITHOUT Parts access does NOT see Parts results
A user WITHOUT Work Orders access does NOT see Work Order results
Results are limited to the signed-in user's own tenant
An entity type with no accessible records shows no group (and its scope tab shows the empty state)
GET /api/search returns grouped results for scope=all
The scope parameter restricts GET /api/search to a single entity type
GET /api/search caps each group at the limit (default 5) and returns per-group totals
GET /api/search matches identifier fields exactly after normalization
GET /api/search does NOT apply fuzzy matching to identifier fields
GET /api/search enforces role-based access on the server (no forbidden entity results)
GET /api/search returns an error response the UI can degrade on
GET /api/search groups results in the fixed group order with ranking metadata
GET /api/search supports cursor pagination for a scoped tab
The context parameter biases GET /api/search ranking to the current page
Recent-entities endpoints record and return recent activity
Search input is debounced before the backend is queried
Contacts are a searchable entity with their own result row and tab
Purchase Orders searchable; real number format; Receive quick action
Vendor Invoices searchable; tri-state payment badge; no quick action
Nine-entity permission bundles hide rows and counts; price fields masked
Scoped tab shows the full result list with load-more; no Show-all link (v2)
Group order follows the v2 nine-entity sequence; pinned top hit above groups
Quick actions per entity include PO Receive and Part Sale Add part (v2)
Recent-entities API records views and serves a deduped, permission-filtered list
WO, Inventory Parts and Customers list search served by the unified engine
Old global-search path is removed on direct rollout (no feature flag)
Global search works on mobile/tablet viewports per the mobile design
